max_hops.description: Maximum TTL (hops) to accept. 0 for no limit.

servers_to_print.description: Number of top-scoring servers to print. 0 to disable.

test_packets.description: Number of packets to send for accurate results.

use_icmp.description: If true, use ICMP probes instead of UDP.

print_dns_names.description: If true, print DNS names instead of IPs.

restrict_ipv4.description: If true, restrict lookups to IPv4.

restrict_ipv6.description: If true, restrict lookups to IPv6.

hosts.description: List of hostnames to test for speed.
